integrity: Self-contained proof and an exact rational sign certificate; numerical integrations are corroboration, not formal certification.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns linear local invasion, constant host/vector loss rates and fixed per-contact coefficients, no vertical infection and no shrinking adjustment. Not a global nonlinear persistence result. Full-text priority search bounded; Bacaer 2007 manuscript inaccessible.
title: A strict all-amplitude seasonality penalty and a reversed invasion verdict for host–vector epidemics
